Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Light Speed

You have trained your killing intent to better adapt to the process of gaining properties of light. If you fail your saving throw when using Light Speed, you only take 10 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, as a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, you can activate Light Speed as a bonus action, sacrificing speed and damage for quicker activation. When used in this way, the length you travel and the damage dice of the technique is halved. This cannot be used with Maximum Output.
